title: The level sets of the fibre-dimension function are locally constructible
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism, the level sets of the function giving the dimension of the fibres are shown to be locally constructible. The proof reduces to the affine case, expresses the fibre dimension by the dimension of a finitely presented algebra modulo a prime, and applies the constructibility criterion for such dimension conditions. Expressing the fibre dimension as a constructible condition on a finitely presented algebra is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 8466-8489.
